   403                  INC(1); /* treat next char normally */
   404              }
   405              break;
   406
   407          case '"':
   408              INC(1);
   409              while ((r = _parse_param_quoted(state,
   410                                              is_structured,
   411                                              is_multivalued)) == PE_QSTRING_EOV) {
   412                  vcardparameter_add_value_from_string(state->param,
   413                                                       buf_cstring(&state->buf));
   414
   415                  buf_reset(&state->buf);
   416                  INC(1);
   417              }
   418              if (r) {
   419                  return r;
   420              }
   421              break;
   422
   423          case ':':
   424          case ';':
   425              /* done - end of parameter */
   426              if (is_multivalued) {
   427                  vcardparameter_add_value_from_string(state->param,
   428                                                       buf_cstring(&state->buf));
   429              } else {
   430                  vcardparameter_set_value_from_string(state->param,
   680                          /* ignore unescaped backslash at end of line */
   681                          INC(2);
   682                          goto out;
   683                      }
   684                      INC(2);
   685                  }
   686              }
   687              if (state->p[1]) {
   688                  /* preserve escape sequences */
   689                  PUTC('\\');
   690                  PUTC(state->p[1]);
   691                  INC(2);
   692              } else {
   693                  /* ignore unescaped backslash at end of line */
   694                  INC(1);
   695                  goto out;
   696              }
   697              break;
   698          case '\r':
   699              INC(1);
   700              break; /* just skip */
   701          case '\n':
   702              if (state->p[1] == ' ' || state->p[1] == '\t') { /* wrapped line */
   703                  INC(2);
   704                  break;
   705              }
   706              /* otherwise it's the end of the value */
   707              INC(1);
   708              goto out;
   709
   710          default:
   711              PUTC(*state->p);
   712              INC(1);
   713              break;
   714          }
   715      }
   716
   717  out:
   718      /* reaching the end of the file isn't a failure here,
   719       * it's just another type of end-of-value */
   720
   721      /* repair critical property values */
   722      if (prop_kind == VCARD_VERSION_PROPERTY) {
   723          buf_trim(&state->buf);
   724          state->version = state->prop;
   725      }
   726
   727      if (state->value_kind == VCARD_TEXTLIST_VALUE) {
   728          char sep = vcardproperty_is_structured(prop_kind) ? ';' : ',';
   729          vcardstrarray *textlist =
   730              vcardtextlist_new_from_string(buf_cstring(&state->buf), sep);
   731          if (textlist) {
   732              value = vcardvalue_new_textlist(textlist);
   733          }
   734      } else {
   735          value = vcardvalue_new_from_string(state->value_kind,
   736                                             buf_cstring(&state->buf));
   737      }
   738
   739      if (!value) {
   740          return PE_VALUE_INVALID;
   741      }
   742
   743      vcardproperty_set_value(state->prop, value);
   744      buf_reset(&state->buf);
   745
   746      return 0;
   747  }

   749  static void _parse_eatline(struct vcardparser_state *state)
   750  {
   751      while (*state->p) {
   752          /* Handle control characters and break for NUL char */
   753          HANDLECTRL(state);
   754
   755          switch (*state->p) {
   756          case '\n':
   757              if (state->p[1] == ' ' || state->p[1] == '\t') { /* wrapped line */
   758                  INC(2);
   759                  break;
   760              }
   830                           vcardproperty_kind_to_string(prop_kind));
   831          }
   832      }
   833  }

   835  static int _parse_vcard(struct vcardparser_state *state,
   836                          vcardcomponent *comp, int only_one)
   837  {
   838      vcardcomponent *sub;
   839      const char *cardstart = state->p;
   840      int r = 0;
   841
   842      while (*state->p) {
   843          /* whitespace is very skippable before AND afterwards */
   844          if (*state->p == '\r' || *state->p == '\n' ||
   845              *state->p == ' ' || *state->p == '\t') {
   846              INC(1);
   847              continue;
   848          }
   849
   850          _parse_prop(state);
   851
   852          if (vcardproperty_isa(state->prop) == VCARD_BEGIN_PROPERTY) {
   853              const char *val =
   854                  vcardvalue_get_text(vcardproperty_get_value(state->prop));
   855              vcardcomponent_kind kind = vcardcomponent_string_to_kind(val);
   856
   857              if (kind == VCARD_NO_COMPONENT) {
   858                  state->itemstart = cardstart;
   859                  r = PE_MISMATCHED_CARD;
   860                  break;
   861              }
   862
   863              vcardproperty_free(state->prop);
   864              state->prop = NULL;
   865
   866              sub = vcardcomponent_new(kind);
   867              vcardcomponent_add_component(comp, sub);
   868              r = _parse_vcard(state, sub, /*only_one*/ 0);
   869              if (r || only_one) {
   870                  break;
   871              }
   872          } else if (!comp) {
   873              /* no comp means we're at the top level, haven't seen a BEGIN! */
   874              state->itemstart = cardstart;
   875              r = PE_MISMATCHED_CARD;
   876              break;
   877          } else if (vcardproperty_isa(state->prop) == VCARD_END_PROPERTY) {
   878              const char *val =
   879                  vcardvalue_get_text(vcardproperty_get_value(state->prop));
   880              vcardcomponent_kind kind = vcardcomponent_string_to_kind(val);
   881
   882              if (kind != vcardcomponent_isa(comp)) {
   883                  /* special case mismatched card, the "start" was the start of
   884                   * the card */
   885                  state->itemstart = cardstart;
   886                  r = PE_MISMATCHED_CARD;
   887              }
   888
   889              break;
   890          } else {
   891              vcardcomponent_add_property(comp, state->prop);
   892              state->prop = NULL;
   893          }
   894      }
   895
   896      if (state->prop) {
   897          if (vcardproperty_isa(state->prop) != VCARD_END_PROPERTY) {
   898              r = PE_FINISHED_EARLY;
   899          }
   900
   901          vcardproperty_free(state->prop);
   902          state->prop = NULL;
   903      }
   904
   905      return r;
   906  }
